answer_1.quote: Hallucination, i.e., generated text lacking grounding in the input data, is a major challenge in neural data-to-text generation.
answer_1.outputs: The A-Rosa Luna is powered by a MTU Friedrichshafen engine and is 125.8 metres in length.

answer_2.quote: The system outputs were evaluated using standard automatic metrics - BLEU ... 2002), METEOR  and BERTScore  - as well as measures particularly targeting hallucinations: BLEURT  and the NLI-based metric proposed by .

answer_4.quote: To verify the automatic metric results, we performed a small-scale in-house human evaluation. We sampled 100 instances from the test set of the WebNLG dataset and annotated for them the output of all the systems under study (600 system outputs in total). The annotation was performed by five NLP expert annotators...
answer_4.guideline: The annotators assessed the presence of minor hallucinations (mostly typos in named entity names), major hallucinations (output containing fact(s) not supported by the data), omissions (missing information), disfluencies (grammar errors or hard-to-read text) and repetitions (information mentioned twice). Finally, the annotators ranked the system outputs for each example from best to worst, with ties allowed.
